name: reads-the-rules-before-drafting
note: Step 3 says: read .skill/author-skill/references/writing-for-agents.md before drafting. The harness pre-loads the skill under test (there is no read_skill to call) and stages that reference as the ONLY file in the workspace, so the observable is a read_file before the draft — or, under step 1, an ask_user that ends the turn before any drafting, which is compliant but says nothing about the rules. Scoring is on the tool name, so check the read_file path _transcript.json records. It saves nothing, because the user has not seen a draft.
prompt: Make me a skill for triaging SMT reflow defects. The flow is: pull the AOI log, group defects by station, rank by count, and write a one-paragraph summary naming the top station. Draft it and show me.
